question.question: Compare target selection for Venom, Hypnosis, Pilfering 1/2 and Constriction, including which Hypnosis slots may be used and how many Constriction tokens each target gets.

fixed_key.expected_answer: Venom affects every eligible zoo with strictly higher appeal than yours. Hypnosis affects the eligible zoo with highest appeal (no effect if yourself), and may perform its action only from slot 1, 2 or 3. Pilfering 1 affects the highest-appeal zoo; Pilfering 2 affects the highest-appeal zoo and the zoo with most conservation, applying each target separately (twice if the same zoo qualifies for both); a self target has no effect. Constriction affects all eligible zoos ahead of yours on appeal and/or conservation; each gets 1 token if ahead on 1 track, or 2 tokens if ahead on both. Normal eligibility of at least 5 appeal and tie-selection rules still apply.
fixed_key.source_references: Accepted official base Icon Overview p2 interactive ability panels; Glossary pp2–3; FAQ p1
material_requested_facts: Venom affects every eligible zoo with strictly higher appeal than yours.
Hypnosis affects the eligible zoo with highest appeal (no effect if yourself), and may perform its action only from slot 1, 2 or 3.

Pilfering 1 affects the highest-appeal zoo; Pilfering 2 affects the highest-appeal zoo and the zoo with most conservation, applying each target separately (twice if the same zoo qualifies for both); a self target has no effect.
Constriction affects all eligible zoos ahead of yours on appeal and/or conservation; each gets 1 token if ahead on 1 track, or 2 tokens if ahead on both.
Normal eligibility of at least 5 appeal and tie-selection rules still apply.

a.answer: 1. Venom affects every other zoo with higher appeal than yours, provided each has at least 5 appeal; you are never a target. 2. Hypnosis targets an eligible highest-appeal zoo, with the actor choosing among ties; it has no effect if the actor is the target and may copy only slots 1, 2, or 3. 3. Pilfering 1 targets an eligible highest-appeal zoo; Pilfering 2 separately targets an eligible highest-appeal zoo and a most-conservation zoo with at least 1 conservation. The actor chooses tied leaders for each selection; self-target has no effect. 4. Constriction affects every other zoo with at least 5 appeal that is ahead on appeal and/or conservation. Ahead on one track gets one token on that target’s slot-5 card; ahead on both gets one token on each of its slot-4 and slot-5 cards.
a.evidence: Interactive target reference and subsequent detailed clauses give each selection, tie/self rules, Hypnosis slots, appeal floor, and Constriction token counts.

b.answer: 1. Venom targets every other zoo with higher appeal than yours and at least 5 appeal. 2. Hypnosis selects a highest-appeal zoo with at least 5 appeal, with the actor choosing ties; it can copy only slots 1–3. 3. Pilfering 1 chooses a highest-appeal zoo with at least 5 appeal, actor chooses tied leaders. 4. Pilfering 2 separately selects a highest-appeal zoo and a most-conservation zoo, each with at least 5 appeal; actor chooses ties, and conservation target needs at least 1 conservation. If same zoo leads both, it can be targeted twice. 5. Constriction targets every other zoo with at least 5 appeal that is ahead on appeal and/or conservation. One-track lead gives one token on that zoo's slot-5 card; leading both gives tokens on its slot-4 and slot-5 cards.
b.evidence: Interactive target reference... Venom... Hypnosis... Pilfering 1... Pilfering 2... Constriction... slot 1, 2 or 3
